headline: YNW Melly’s Mother Shares An Emotional Message As He Approaches Nearly 8 Years Behind Bars
body: YNW Melly’s Mother Shares An Emotional Message As He Approaches Nearly 8 Years Behind Bars Without A Guilty Verdict. “Almost 8 Years Later And My Heart Still Aches Everyday,” She Wrote, Calling Melly Her “First Heartbeat” And Saying She’s Patiently Waiting For Him To Come Home. 🏽 The Rapper Has Been In Custody Since 2018 While Facing Double-Murder Charges, With His Case Still Ongoing YNWMelly FreeMelly YNW. Allegations are not findings of guilt.
